fusions.name: Run Them Down
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 5% for every tenth of its health the target still has (max 25%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stamping Ground
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 3 damage, each with a 25% chance to be [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
